panel.title: GitHub application updates
panel.subtitle: Track GitHub Releases for apps outside your usual package sources. Add a repository or release URL, then choose the Linux asset and install format.
panel.empty: No repositories registered yet. Add one below.
status.ready: Configured GitHub apps are up to date

add.title: Add a GitHub repository or Release URL
add.targetPlaceholder: Absolute AppImage path (only for a manual AppImage choice)
add.hint: Automatic picks the install format for this system, reuses an installed AppImage (file or extracted folder), and decides where a new AppImage goes. Version and path can stay blank.
notice.adding: Saving app to the local tracking list…
notice.added: Added %1 to local tracking. GitHub checks run afterward.
